items.text: Raymond James discloses that its competitive pay packages include base salary, incentive bonus, and equity compensation programs, plus retirement plans (ESOP, profit-sharing, 401(k) match, employee stock purchase plan) and non-qualified deferred compensation plans.
items.quote: Our competitive pay packages include base salary, incentive bonus, and equity compensation programs.

items.text: The firm discloses that employee financial advisors' compensation primarily includes a payout on revenues they generate plus participation in employee benefit plans, while independent contractor financial advisors receive a higher payout percentage because they are responsible for their own direct costs.
items.quote: Compensation for these financial advisors primarily includes a payout on revenues they generate and such advisors also participate in the firm's employee benefit plans.

items.text: Raymond James discloses specific payout ranges by affiliation model: Traditional Employee up to 50% payout, Advisor Select 70-80% gross payout, Independent Contractor 81% to 90% payout, and Corporate RIA 81% to 90% payout; the RIA & Custody Services model has the advisor work with their RIA/broker-dealer to determine compensation.
items.quote: Traditional Employee... Up to 50% payout**... Advisor Select... 70-80% gross payout**... Independent Contractor... 81% to 90% payout***... Corporate RIA... 81% to 90% payout***

items.text: The CEO states the firm has tiered payout systems on the employee side (higher production moves an advisor up the payout grid), and that independent payouts are higher than employee payouts because independents cover their own overhead, real estate, health insurance, etc.
items.quote: even on the employee side, we have tiered payout systems. And so as production increases, you kind of get higher up on the payout grid as well.

items.text: The ADV discloses that newly affiliated RJA financial advisors through the Advisor Mastery Program may receive a salary in addition to advisory fees (or commissions and trails) for a period of time, and that an advisor's payout share rises with annual revenue generation.
items.quote: Newly affiliated RJA financial advisors through our Advisor Mastery Program may receive a salary in addition to advisory fees (or salary in addition to commissions and trails in the case of transactions in brokerage accounts) for a period of time.

items.text: The ADV discloses financial incentives for affiliation, including transition assistance, bonuses, deferred compensation arrangements, enhanced pay-outs, repayable business transition or working capital loans, and administrative fee reimbursements, as well as recognition clubs with paid travel and deferred compensation awards.
items.quote: These arrangements include, but are not limited to, transition assistance, bonuses, deferred compensation arrangements, enhanced pay-outs, repayable business transition or working capital loans, and administrative fee reimbursements.

items.text: The firm defines PCG recruiting and retention-related compensation (cash and equity awards issued for recruiting, retention of existing advisors, or acquisitions, expensed over 5-10 years) and discloses figures for it, such as $117 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and $335 million for the nine months then ended, broken out from other financial advisor compensation.
